Courses Eligibility

Sc./ IT/ Informatics Practices/ Agriculture/ Engineering Graphics/ Business studies as optional subjects with the above-mentioned aggregate percentage (40% for SC/ST/OBC candidates (except Creamy layer) candidates belonging to Madhya Pradesh) in subjects taken together. reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Engineering College Nowgong.

review_content.Placements: There were no placements in this college. I would not recommend students to join this college. We could apply for off-campus placements, but there was no opportunity in this college.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was good. There was a small library in this college. Separate hostels were available for both boys and girls. Sports were conducted in this college. The food served in the mess was very good. Medical facilities were provided.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers were average. Workshops were not conducted in this college. Teachers did not provide practical knowledge to students.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Engineering College Nowgong.

review_content.Placements: There were no proper placements opportunity at NEC. Principal and faculty members do not care about the students, neither they invite any company for the placements. Therefore, there were no prior placements opportunity at Government Engineering College Nowgong. Everything was for the namesake.
review_content.Infrastructure: In this college, students had to stay in someone else's building. Students continued there for more than 3 years then students were shifted to the new building. However, the building was new, but no new course for the academic development of students. Hostel or mess was not provided in this college.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: I am not satisfied because of its faculty members and infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: The placements facility is not available right now. They never try to invite companies into their campus. Around 60% of students get internships from civil engineering courses.
review_content.Infrastructure: The quality of facilities in the hostel, quality of food available in the mess is average. The sports facilities are also good. The quality of the main building of this college is not good, and washrooms are not properly worked every time, and there is always a problem in the supply system of water.
review_content.Faculty: Faculty members are average, and they are only noticed on toppers. One more thing about faculty members is that sometimes there is a shortage of faculty members, and they are dependent on private faculty members which are not knowledgeable. The semester exam is not difficult to pass the semester exam, and the pass percentage is 40%.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: If you have any financial problems to afford a top college, then you can choose this college.

review_content.Placements: This college has been established very recently, and it got its own new building last year. So, you can't expect much from this college. Till 2020, there were no placements, but it will also start very soon. Till 2020, only 2 branches were offered in the college, civil and mechanical. Soon, some new branches will also be introduced. Internships are mandatory as RGPV curriculum.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college got its new building in 2020, the infrastructure is amazing, but it is quite far from the main city place. The library has a lot of books, and all the books are in new condition. Till 2020, there was no Wi-Fi. The classrooms are excellent, well-equipped with smart projectors. As it is a government college, there is no problem with funds. So, things will become amazing very soon. There is only one hostel. In the coming years, some more hostels will be developed. Since students were not allotted the hostel till 2020, the mess condition is unknown till now. For the past years, this college didn't have its own campus, so various factors like Wi-Fi and medical facilities are unknown. Games and sports events are organised in the college.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Good infrastructure and facility and decent placement.

review_content.Placements: Here in college percentage of students getting placed is about 60% and average salary is 2.5 lakhs and top recruiting companies TCS, Infosys but you cannot depend only on campus placement you have to make efforts to get a good job. So you have to prepare yourself for off campus as well.
review_content.Infrastructure: Here in college a good network connectivity is available good labs infrastructure is good, library is good and most important all the machines that are used for mechanical engineering also present. I can't tell about hostel because I don't live in hostel but medical facility are very good, sports facilities are also good.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: If only government college is the option and the score is below average, this is the best option.

review_content.Placements: There is no placement facility in the college as it is a new college. So I can't say much about it. There's a placement cell. Since my 1st year in college, students are informed that this year there'll be placement. But I'm in the final year now. My degree is almost about to complete, and still, there are no placements.
review_content.Infrastructure: As of now, the infrastructure of the college is quite good as the building was shifted to a newly constructed campus last year. The campus is huge, but it's mostly mud, grass, and lake. There are primarily 2 buildings. One is for the civil branch and one for the mechanical. There's no parking facility. We have to park bikes in the mud. There is no canteen. But there are shops a bit outside the main campus, where there are basics snacks available.

reviews.review_heading: If you have any financial problems to afford a top college, then you can choose this college.
reviews.review_text: Our college got its new building in 2020, the infrastructure is amazing, but it is quite far from the main city place. The library has a lot of books, and all the books are in new condition. Till 2020, there was no Wi-Fi. The classrooms are excellent, well-equipped with smart projectors. As it is a government college, there is no problem with funds. So, things will become amazing very soon. There is only one hostel. In the coming years, some more hostels will be developed. Since students were no...

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facility and decent placement.
reviews.review_text: Here in college a good network connectivity is available good labs infrastructure is good, library is good and most important all the machines that are used for mechanical engineering also present. I can't tell about hostel because I don't live in hostel but medical facility are very good, sports facilities are also good.

reviews.review_heading: If only government college is the option and the score is below average, this is the best option.
reviews.review_text: As of now, the infrastructure of the college is quite good as the building was shifted to a newly constructed campus last year. The campus is huge, but it's mostly mud, grass, and lake. There are primarily 2 buildings. One is for the civil branch and one for the mechanical. There's no parking facility. We have to park bikes in the mud. There is no canteen. But there are shops a bit outside the main campus, where there are basics snacks available.

reviews.review_heading: This college doesn't make students engineers.
reviews.review_text: In the previous year, our college has shifted from its temporary campus to its permanent campus. The new campus is good. It has a library with a limited number of books, so every student doesn't get books. There is no Wi-Fi facility for students. However, classrooms are good. The hostel isn't allotted to students now, and maybe it will be allotted soon. One of the worst things about our college is that there is no canteen or food facility and medical facility.

reviews.review_heading: Don't choose any course of this college next 7 years and don't lost your future.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi facility available here. The computer lab is available for students, but it's not working properly. The mechanical lab is not available here. The library is available, but it's not working properly for general category students. There is no canteen available here. The hostel is available here, but it is not in a working condition, and it is very difficult to get a room for general category students. They do not provide any medical facilities. There is a transportation problem i...

reviews.review_heading: Worth College for Mechanical and Civil Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The underconstruction infrastructure is in 200 acres of land in which only mechanical and civil engineering departments are well established with the workshops, labs, Canteen, etc. Electrical and Electronics and Communication department is under construction till now and will be completed soon.

reviews.review_heading: As the college is very new, it is improving very well, and it will fulfil all kind of requirements.
reviews.review_text: Nowgong Engineering College is started in 2012 by our honourable chief minister Shri Shivraj Singh Chouhan. It is one out of the 5 autonomous engineering college of Madhya Pradesh. As it was started with only 2 branches mechanical and civil, it has a small campus which is situated in the college campus of Nowgong Polytechnic College. A new and big campus of the college is building in about 200 acres. It is situated near Navodaya Vidhyalaya Nowgong. This new campus is bigger than the older one, s...

reviews.review_heading: It is a government autonomous college. There are high class facilities and well educated faculty.
reviews.review_text: It is a 200-acre campus, which is well designed. There is a separate building for different branches. The site selection for constructing the building is very good on the side of the mountain and river. This is one of the autonomous government institutes from the 5 institutes. The hostel facility is also there. For the freshers, there are lots of facilities provided.

reviews.review_heading: Good in its own way, a small town college.
reviews.review_text:
The infrastructure is not that big, it is small, but it is good. There is quite a lot of greenery.
It has a good environment for studies. The labs and classrooms are just amazing with very good furniture. There's no canteen as such, but there is a small shop just outside the gate. So, tea and fast food are available easily.

reviews.review_heading: A good option, if you want government engineering college in a small town.
reviews.review_text:
There are many well-furnished classrooms. The computers and equipment in the lab are in good condition, although there are not many labs. The infrastructure is small. However, the faculty is good. The studies part is good. There are enough greenery and parks.
There's also proper stand for cycles, bikes, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and best faculty in the college. After all, this is a govt. engg. college.
reviews.review_text:
Labs, classrooms, library are there. There are no many facilities but in future, there might be more facilities because our new campus is being prepared at behind Navodya School, Nowgong.

In this campus, there are two hostels for boys and girls (separate), 3 buildings for college and a residential building for professors.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for students to obtain a degree with good knowledge and experience.
reviews.review_text: The college had excellent facilities. Wi-Fi, computer labs, chemistry labs, and mechanical labs were available. There were digital classrooms, and we also had a large library with many amenities. We had a huge hostel with enough rooms. Water and electricity facilities were available. The quality of the food was good. Our college hosted numerous sports competitions that included both indoor and outdoor games.

review_summary.college_name: Karmayogi Engineering College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Computer Technology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It has well-qualified faculty members and a state-of-the-art library.

content.Infrastructure: The trust, Pandurang Pratishthan, has purchased around 100 acres of land on the bank of the river Chandrabhaga and completed the college building as well as a separate hostel for boys and girls. It has a state-of-the-art library and many other supporting facilities for the overall development of the students. It consists of a college campus, hostels, and a huge playground. The department has a good infrastructure, having more than 150 highly configured branded computers with major essential peripherals and advanced legal software like Oracle, Windows Server 2008 R2, MS-OFFICE 2010, JCreator, etc. The department has a multimedia lab, a pperating system lab, a microprocessor lab, a digital techniques lab, a programming lab, and a computer centre.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Review of Karmayogi Engineering College.

content.Placements: The placement cell of our institute is extremely remarkable as many students get more than one offer letter from a company. There is 100% assurance of placements. The lowest salary package offered is 4 LPA, and the highest salary package offered is 10 LPA to every student. As I am in the first year now, I am seeing our senior batch from which all students got placed now. Our college also conducts pre mock interviews, group discussions, etc., in order to make students capable of qualifying in interviews.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is well organised, with all the facilities for students. Students get many facilities like study with smartboard accessibility, computer labs and well-furnished classrooms. The classrooms are also well equipped with air-conditioners. There is a well-managed sports room and also a ground to play other outdoor activities.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Review of Karmayogi Engineering College.

content.Placements: Companies do not visit our college properly. Only 1 or 2 companies visit our college with a salary package that ranges from 3-4 LPA. Multinational companies do not visit our college, so students do not get selected by any multinational company.
content.Infrastructure: In our college, sports are conducted well every year. A mess is very good. The hostel infrastructure is good, but the hostel is not clean. Students waste their food in the hostel, and sometimes there is a water problem. Sometimes they waste water. The main important thing is there is no hot water in the hostel, and it is only available for 2 to 3 months in winter. The hostel facility is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with this college as it has a very good study environment and placements.

content.Placements: More than 85% of students get selected in campus placements. The highest salary package offered was 6 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies here are TCS, TCE, Mahindra, Infosys, Accenture, etc. The placement cell is very helpful for students to build their communication skills and extra knowledge.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has good facilities and infrastructure. The campus is fantastic, with surrounding gardens. On the campus, Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms and the library are good enough. The quality of facilities provided in our hostel is good, and the quality of food served is also good. The fee of the hostel is not very high.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with this college as it has a good study environment and placements.

content.Infrastructure: The college has good facilities and infrastructure like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, libraries, experienced teachers etc. The quality of facilities in our hostel and the quality of food available in the mess and canteen is good. individual_reviews.title: It is one of the good colleges in terms of infrastructure.

content.Placements: This college was very good. There were few students so no companies visit our college for recruitment. Teachers guide us about internships. We can opt for software or hardware courses in this college.

content.Faculty: Faculty members were well-educated and knowledgeable. They always help us to solve our doubts. They also provided theory and practical knowledge, so that we could gather good knowledge. They prepared us for the exam to attempt hard questions.

individual_reviews.title: I am not satisfied with its placements.

content.Faculty: Teachers were very talented. We had to study at least 4 chapters to pass each semester. Few teachers were not good because they did not learn Python.

individual_reviews.title: I would not recommend students to join this college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: A geat blend of academics and campus life. Quality education with supportive faculty.

content.Placements: A total of 20% of students got placed from our college with the highest salary package of 7 LPA including companies like Wipro, Tata, Infosys, Litmus, etc. The top roles offered from our college are software developer, project manager, assistant engineer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: As a private college, all the college facilities and infrastructure are very well and well managed. The quality of the college hostel is super and well managed neatly. Each lab is equipped with the necessary tools, equipment, and technology to help students apply theoretical knowledge in a practical environment.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: By looking through the studies, I rate 10 out of 10 to our college.

content.Placements: During the academic year 2021-25, our college successfully placed 20% of the students from the final year batch. The highest salary package is 7 LPA, which is from the top companies like 6D Technologies, Litmus, etc., for a software development role, and also includes non-technical companies.
content.Infrastructure: Our college is a private self-financing college, because of that, the infrastructure of the college is well-maintained. Every classroom and library is neatly kept, with a projector and all the high-tech facilities, including Wi-Fi. There are no medical facilities in our college, but all other activities are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: A good college to learn and become someone in life.

content.Placements: The college placement cell was okay. About 50 to 60% of people in our batch got placed. The lowest package was around 4 LPA, and the highest was around 7 LPA. The top companies were TCS, Wipro, GICE, and Poornam. All students got a one-month break for internships; many went to different companies, such as Keltro. Top roles were software developer, web developer, and technical support.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure and facilities were good. We were provided with internet service, and the labs and classrooms were also good. The library had most of the books for reference. Hostel facilities were provided but were not the best quality. The canteen was okay and worth the price of the food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: The college doesn't provide the life you expect, you have to work for that.

content.Placements: There is a placement cell in the college where the staff help us in every way to get placed. Even though it depends on our skills to get placed. In my batch, 25% students got placed in one way or another. The main recruiting companies are TCS and VVDN etc.
content.Infrastructure: There are all basic facilities that a college needs, and the college is situated in a calm natural environment where the mother nature itself provides a good atmosphere. The canteen and cafeteria are average and the facilities for games are there but are limited.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Overall, a satisfactory experience made possible by good faculty and infrastructure.

content.Placements: 15% of the students in the electronics and communication branch were placed in the year 2021. The top recruiting company for ECE was Tata Consultancy Services. Most offered position for ECE students was System Engineer, System Analyst along with various others.
content.Infrastructure: All amenities and facilities provided are of excellent quality. Well-equipped classrooms, labs and libraries are provided with tools for virtual learning. Accommodation facilities are satisfactory. The canteen provides varieties of food of nutritional value and good quality. Ample sports facilities are available like Cricket and Soccer field, table tennis and badminton equipment, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am very much dissatisfied with this college.

content.Placements: They actually don't provide internships. One has to prepare for internships as well as placements on their own. There are no on-campus opportunities. Students are taking themselves because the college is not perfect for industry. This college is basically for Diploma and Nursing students.
content.Infrastructure: Instruments are not workable in labs. The library doesn't have sufficient or varied books. Management is very poor, and Wi-Fi is not available on every floor. The hostel is worse than I have ever seen, and the mess food doesn't have varieties.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: It is a very good college for events and fests.

content.Placements: Our college doesn't provide placement opportunities to students, but they provide very good internship opportunities in the third year. Many good companies like Euro India Foods, etc., visit our college to offer internships. Around 70-75% of students get internship opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities provided in our college for students are a well-stocked library, computer labs, and fully equipped classrooms. It has a very good canteen facility. The quality of the food is good. It serves a variety of dishes. There is a basketball court for sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Overall the university is quite good, I would recommend this college, my college experience.

content.Placements: The placement scenario is very good. Around 85% of students were placed. The highest package was of 60lpa for ce and ee departments. The average is about 25lpa. The major companies like google, Amazon etc. Came for placements. Most of the students prepare for the PG examination and very few get placed into jobs immediately after their graduation.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has all the necessary infrastructure, facilities and equipments. Classrooms have a capacity of about 250 students and are equipped with projectors. Wi-Fi facility is also available in academic blocks and students dorms. Tje labs and classrooms are well-equipped. Library is bit large. Classrooms have projector screens, blackboards.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Faculty members are good but the hostel infrastructure and placements are not good.

content.Placements: Not many companies visited our college. As I'm in chemical engineering semester 2 students. In my class, there are only two students from our branch. There are 5 branches in our college namely, chemical, electrical, mechanical, civil, and computer branch.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel infrastructure is not so good. The hostel fee is Rs.6000 per month. You'll get breakfast in the morning, lunch in the afternoon, one cup of tea in the evening, and dinner at night. In the hostel room, there are at least 30 beds in one room.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Prime Group of Institutions is the best college.

content.Placements: Almost students got recruited from various branches such as civil, chemical, mechanical, and computer science. Every student gets an opportunity for an interview. I have no idea about the salary package because I will be passing out next year.
content.Infrastructure: There are five buildings on campus. The boys' and girls' hostels are separated. Moreover, laboratories are equipped with the latest equipment and all the required equipment is available in the laboratories. Mess is also good. The campus is beautifully developed.

review_summary.college_name: World Institute of Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: I'm dissatisfied with our college due to teachers and the availability of placement training.

content.Placements: Our college is not good for placements. They only attract students to take admission in this college. They say that many companies visited to hire students for jobs, but it is not true. Companies visited here, but they hire some students. I am not satisfied with our college regarding placements and training.
content.Infrastructure: Our college infrastructure is good, but still, it needs maintenance. However, our college director does not take any action to maintain college infrastructure. Lab equipment is not in working condition. Wi-Fi is available only for the name, but it did not work. The library is good with many books, and it is well-maintained. Classrooms are very good, but the air-conditioners are not working.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Review of World Institute of Technology.

content.Placements: After 2014, there is no placement record in any branch of B.Tech. I was in this college from 2014 to 2018 in the mechanical engineering branch, and there were no placements in those years. Before 2014, some reputed companies visited the college and recruited some students.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are available for boys and girls. The hostel infrastructure is good. Labs are good for mechanical engineering, civil, and computer science. Canteen and the mess are not that good. There is a field for playing games like cricket, badminton, football and volleyball.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) (Lateral Entry) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: I'm studying here for the last three years. My experience with this college is very bad.

content.Placements: I completed my diploma from this college. During our admission, they said that there are 100% placements, but the fact is that none of the students got placed through the college placements. Now, I took admission in this college in B.Tech civil engineering. This time, I hope they succeed in providing placements to students in good companies.
content.Infrastructure: Mechanical engineering labs and computer science engineering labs in the college are good, but the condition of civil engineering labs is very bad. No one cleans these labs, and the equipment in the labs is bad. The hostel is also bad as shared by my classmates. Classrooms are good but not very well. There are no sports facilities. My college won't share Wi-Fi password with students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: The college was good till 2016, but there is nothing good after that.

content.Placements: The college is not providing any placement opportunities from a few years. In the initial years of the college, a few good companies visited the campus for placements but now, not even a single company is visiting the campus for placements. So the college is not good regarding placements. The college has a training and placement cell, but the staff members in the placement cell are not working efficiently.
content.Infrastructure: The building and infrastructure are good for academic purposes. The hostel is good, and the entire campus is enabled with Wi-Fi. Labs are also good for some branches like CSE, ECE, mechanical and civil. The library is good for the students to study. Classrooms are good. Games and sports facilities are available for the students who are interested in sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: Our college is not a good choice for someone who really wants to study.

content.Placements: There are only 10% of placements in our college and that too if you are ready to work for any package. Not only this college but every college affiliated to MDU has the same story. Overall, if you want only a degree to do masters, then this is the best college for you.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is far better than other colleges in this area. We have a CNC machine in the workshop for mechanical engineers. We have different buildings for different branches and a big ground for football and cricket.

review_summary.college_name: Priyadarshini Institute of Technology and Management (PITM, Guntur) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: The college is very pretty and good, with well developed infrastructure.

content.Placements: Students are pretty good and comfortable. The faculty are also good. 90% of students get placements without placement assurance. For mechanical students, MNCs and core companies offer placements. Companies that come for our branch are TCS, Wipro, Accenture, Infosys etc.
content.Infrastructure: The labs have well-developed infrastructure, such as AutoCAD, workshop, CAD/CAM etc. Classrooms are very good, peaceful, and well designed, with smart classes and fans. We have a very good library with many books to read. We have the best hostel facilities ever, and they offer study rooms as well.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: I am very dissatisfied with this college and I don't want any student to spoil their life here.

content.Placements: We got placements in BPOs in our academic year. 30% of the students got placed in those placements. The package offered was very low when we compare to regular ones. In our academic year, no one got an internship from our college. Our college is useless for placements.
content.Infrastructure: Our classrooms were average. The library was good. We don't have any Wi-Fi or internet facility. They don't encourage sports and games, not only that, we don't have a proper canteen even. We don't have hostel facilities. The college is located between cotton yields, so it's very hot in our classroom.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: One of the best colleges I have ever seen.

content.Placements: Our college has a very good placement cell in charge who gets as many companies as possible to bring placements into the college for its students and even keeps the offline drives. My seniors got placed in many MNCs in their final year itself. In my batch also, all of them got selected in many companies. I got selected in one of the best companies and working at present.
content.Infrastructure: Our college contains the best in class infrastructure. The best labs, equipment for doing lab projects and every classroom consists projector as some topics are explained through PPT presentations. For games, all types of facilities and courts are present in the college. And, the hostel facilities are good. The food in the hostels is of the best quality. Our college has got the best infrastructure award in the year, 2013.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: Good placements and good infrastructure to learn the subjects.

content.Placements: In our college, there are nice placements like Wipro, TCS etc. The faculty of our college encourages us to participate because if you get the job or not first, we have to try, and it will be the experience to you. The highest salary is Rs. 30,000 per month and the lowest salary is Rs. 15,000 per month.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very well to develop our skills. There are nice labs to develop our skills, and we have lab facilities with the Wi-Fi connectivity, where you can bring your laptop and start your work in the surroundings of our college. I didn't face any infrastructure problems in my college life.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: College is good but placements are not there.

content.Placements: 3-4 companies came to the campus but they were small companies only. One company named Kripa LED came for campus placements and some people got selected. The salary offered by them was 4 lakhs per annum. It is a good college but lacks in placements. I did an internship and there was no stipend for that, because it is a middle-range company and they are not giving a stipend to any of their people.
content.Infrastructure: The college is good and it is under construction for the fourth and fifth floors. The college had Wi-Fi, a library,and a clubroom. The classrooms are a little bit good and they are improving all the rooms and interiors for implementing ACs. The labs are also good in the college. The canteen is small but the food there is nice.
